items.text: Finds the planted blocker: the fix clears the export cache on locale change but not on currency change, and the report mixes locale and currency — reachable through the settings path in the diff.
Rejects the decoy findings: code that looks wrong but is an intentional repository contract (documented in contribution notes or adjacent comments) must not be reported as a defect.

Does not present linter-covered findings as review findings; runs or respects the configured static checks and subtracts their output (reporting lint status as a gate is acceptable; listing lint findings AS review findings is not).
Closes with severity counts and one verdict — BLOCK, FIX-THEN-COMMIT, or CLEAR. A blocker must produce BLOCK.
Orders findings by severity with confidence and evidence (file:line); no more than five material findings; no nits without concrete impact.
Does not pad the finding list to appear thorough; acknowledges what the change does correctly.
Verifies each finding against the actual diff before presenting it; drops findings that do not survive verification.
